content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate in Life Sciences/ Environmental Science from a recognized Board/University with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Other conditions: Local geographical knowledge of Haryana and possession of a valid driving license. Desirable: Preference will be given to M.Sc./ M.Tech in Life Sciences/ Environmental Science/Environmental Engineering. Experience in field monitoring, maintenance of outdoor cultures/tanks, basic laboratory assistance, and willingness to travel across various sites in Haryana.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: 3 months after joining in the 1st year or upto end of the financial year 2026-2027 i.e. 31.03.2027, whichever is earlier (extendable up to project completion for duration of 03 months only in 2nd year based on performance and fund availability).

content_sections.heading: How Will GJUS&T Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview will be held on 16.11.2026 at 11:00 A.M.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GJUS&T Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send detailed CV/Resume via email to Principal Investigator Dr. Anita Singh Kirrolia at [email protected] on or before 10.11.2026 up to 5:00 P.M. Write APPLICATION FOR FIELD STAFF in the subject of the email.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
